text:
There's no parking available. (I recommend parking on the street and walking to the clinic; the alley next to the clinic is very narrow and may be full.)

Personally, having been to several dental clinics, I think this dentist has a heavy hand.
I got a tool stuck in my throat while they were prying it open. It hurt.
After the procedure, the dentist apologized, but said it was a very strong and painful stab. I swallowed a lot of the anesthetic, and the assistant didn't properly section the area during the injection. It tasted very bitter. They pried open the corner of my mouth until it was swollen and red. I felt like I'd been beaten up. I understand about the swelling and other issues.

- Cleanliness 3/5 (The cover smelled terrible; it was either sterilized or reused.)

- Queueing 2/5 (I kept my appointment and waited in line. Walk-ins were also served ahead of me, getting anesthetic injections and waiting until the numbness wore off before being treated.)

- Safety 1.5/5 (No radiation shielding was used for X-rays.)

I thought it was cheap, but ended up paying extra, comparable to my regular clinic. I got bruising (excessive) and a throat stab wound.
